entries.title: Hebrews 13:1
segments: Let your love for the Brethren continue. :24 Give our greeting to all your Leaders, and to all Christ's People. Our friends from Italy send their greetings to you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:2
segments: Do not neglect to show hospitality; for, through being hospitable, men have all unawares entertained angels.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:3
segments: Remember the prisoners, as if you were their fellow-prisoners, and the oppressed, not forgetting that you also are still in the body.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:4
segments: Let marriage be honoured by all and the married life be pure; for God will judge those who are immoral and those who commit adultery.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:5
segments: Do not let your conduct be ruled by the love of money. Be content with what you have, for God himself has said-- 'I will never forsake you, nor will I ever abandon you.'

entries.title: Hebrews 13:6
segments: Therefore we may say with confidence-- 'The Lord is my helper, I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?'

entries.title: Hebrews 13:7
segments: Do not forget your Leaders, the men who told you God's Message. Recall the close of their lives, and imitate their faith.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:8
segments: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day--yes, and for ever!

entries.title: Hebrews 13:9
segments: Do not let yourselves be carried away by the various novel forms of teaching. It is better to rely for spiritual strength upon the divine help, than upon regulations regarding food; for those whose lives are guided by such regulations have not found them of service.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:10
segments: We are not without an altar; but it is one at which those who still worship in the Tabernacle have no right to eat.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:11
segments: The bodies of those animals whose blood is brought by the High Priest into the Sanctuary, as an offering for sin, are burnt outside the camp.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:12
segments: And so Jesus, also, to purify the People by his own blood, suffered outside the gate.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:13
segments: Therefore let us go out to him 'outside the camp,' bearing the same reproaches as he;

entries.title: Hebrews 13:14
segments: for here we have no permanent city, but are looking for the City that is to be.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:15
segments: Through him let us offer, as our sacrifice, continual praise to God--an offering from lips that glorify his Name.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:16
segments: Never forget to do kindly acts and to share what you have with others, for such sacrifices are acceptable to God.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:17
segments: Obey your Leaders, and submit to their control, for they are watching over your souls, as men who will have to render an account, so that they may do it with joy, and not in sorrow. That would not be to your advantage.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:18
segments: Pray for us, for we are sure that our consciences are clear, since our wish is to be occupied with what is good.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:19
segments: And I the more earnestly ask for your prayers, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:20
segments: May God, the source of all peace, who brought back from the dead him who, 'by virtue of the blood that rendered valid the unchangeable Covenant, is the Great Shepherd of God's Sheep,' Jesus, our Lord--

entries.title: Hebrews 13:21
segments: may God make you perfect in everything that is good, so that you may be able to do his will. May he bring out in us all that is pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be all glory for ever and ever. Amen.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:22
segments: I beg you, Brothers, to bear with these words of advice. For I have written only very briefly to you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:23
segments: You will be glad to hear that our Brother, Timothy, has been set free. If he comes here soon, we will visit you together.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:24
segments: Give our greeting to all your Leaders, and to all Christ's People. Our friends from Italy send their greetings to you.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:25
segments: May God bless you all.
